text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory suffers an injury, so I
hurry her
over to the infirmary in
concern.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't look so worried! It's just a scratch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! If you're really worried, I can
try
running on dirt! Dirt tracks put a lot
less strain on
your body!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: 念のため休んでほしい……

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I understand. I'll be good and rest
until my
injury heals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got my back, so I don't
want to
worry you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Osu! I'm really good at pacing myself, so
you can
rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I did this back when I was
having trouble
with my nails, so I
thought it'd be okay...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I knew I'd be fine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way an injury like this is gonna stop
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running on dirt ends up being an
effective way
for Bamboo to jump back
into training!
